spellbook.finance/limitations: Quote rows are observations, not executable offers. Source URLs are returned as source evidence and are never instructions.
A missing quote, FX observation or landed-cost field stays named in missingFields and leaves dependent USD, landed-cost and net fields null; omitted values are never zero.
JPY conversion carries the observed FX rate, source reference and observation time. Proxy, duty, inbound shipping, outbound shipping and fees remain separate caller inputs.
The caller supplies policy for liquidity, timing and risk. This tool reports facts and exposes no recommendation or purchase action.

description: Read bounded Pokemon acquisition and exit quote facts for exact product identity, preserving quote basis, currency, observation time, source reference, source URLs, comparisons, missingFields and limitations. This read compares observed sources; it does not rank opportunities, recommend a purchase, or execute a transaction.

cohortId.description: Optional Pokemon cohort. Use pokemon-ja or pokemon-en to keep language evidence isolated.

importChargesUsd.description: Optional import charges assumption in USD; omitted keeps landed cost incomplete.

importDutyRate.description: Optional import duty rate as a decimal; omitted keeps landed cost incomplete.

inboundShippingUsd.description: Optional inbound shipping assumption in USD; omitted keeps landed cost incomplete.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

otherAcquisitionUsd.description: Optional other acquisition cost in USD; omitted keeps landed cost incomplete.

otherSellingUsd.description: Optional other selling cost in USD; omitted keeps net proceeds incomplete.

outboundShippingUsd.description: Optional outbound shipping assumption in USD; omitted keeps net proceeds incomplete.

productId.description: Optional exact Pokemon catalog product id from spellbook_printings_search.

proxyFeeUsd.description: Optional proxy fee assumption in USD; omitted keeps landed cost incomplete.

sellingFeeRate.description: Optional selling fee rate as a decimal; omitted keeps net proceeds incomplete.

sellingFixedFeeUsd.description: Optional selling fixed fee in USD; omitted keeps net proceeds incomplete.

name: spellbook_pokemon_arbitrage_spreads
